school_name: State University of New York at New Paltz

boards.school_name: State University of New York at New Paltz
boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented SUNY New Paltz milestones and recurring campus celebrations, from welcoming new Hawks to recognizing graduates and scholarship.

cards.title: Lantern Ceremony
cards.subtitle: Alumni Reunion tradition
cards.notes: Look for the Reunion schedule and ceremony coverage when alumni return to campus; it recognizes anniversary classes as part of the gathering.
cards.short_summary: An annual Reunion ceremony for alumni milestone classes.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz identifies the Lantern Ceremony as an annual tradition and reported it as part of Alumni Reunion 2025.
cards.access_notes: Program details and participation are announced with Alumni Reunion programming.

cards.title: Senior Toast
cards.subtitle: Pre-Commencement celebration
cards.notes: Graduating seniors can watch Commencement-season announcements for this gathering, which marks the transition from student to alum before graduation.
cards.short_summary: A recurring pre-Commencement celebration for graduating seniors.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz called the 2026 Senior Toast a much-loved pre-Commencement tradition held annually for graduating seniors.
cards.source_title: A Senior Toast to the SUNY New Paltz Class of 2026
cards.access_notes: Intended for graduating seniors; event details are shared by the University each spring.

cards.title: First World Graduation
cards.subtitle: Commencement-weekend community ceremony
cards.notes: Follow First World New Paltz and Commencement communications for this student-run ceremony, which recognizes graduating students from underrepresented backgrounds.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz reports that First World New Paltz has hosted its special annual Commencement-weekend event for more than five decades.
cards.source_title: ‘This ceremony is for you’: First World New Paltz celebrates community on 2025 Commencement weekend
cards.access_notes: The University describes the event as open to all members of the campus community.

cards.title: New Student Convocation
cards.subtitle: Fall welcome on Old Main Quad
cards.notes: New students can check Welcome Week information for the procession, ceremony, class photo and campus gathering that officially opens their University experience.
cards.short_summary: The annual welcome rite for incoming first-year and transfer students.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz describes New Student Convocation as an annual fall celebration and a Welcome Week rite of passage.
cards.source_title: It’s official! SUNY New Paltz Academic Year 2025-26 kicks off at Convocation
cards.access_notes: Held during Welcome Week; verify the current academic year's date and location through University announcements.

cards.title: New Student Convocation Class Photo
cards.subtitle: Annual incoming-class snapshot
cards.notes: Join the incoming class after Convocation when the annual photo is made; it records the class at the beginning of its New Paltz journey.
cards.short_summary: A documented annual photo moment attached to New Student Convocation.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz reported that its 2025 Convocation concluded with the annual class photo.
cards.source_title: It’s official! SUNY New Paltz Academic Year 2025-26 kicks off at Convocation
cards.access_notes: Part of Convocation; current timing is announced through Welcome Week programming.

cards.title: Move-In Day
cards.subtitle: Incoming Hawks’ campus arrival
cards.notes: Incoming resident students should use Housing and Welcome Week instructions; volunteers help students and families settle into residence halls each year.
cards.short_summary: The annual arrival-day welcome for the newest Hawks.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz called Move-In Day a tradition that returns each year through volunteer support from the campus community.
cards.source_title: Welcoming our new Hawks: Move-In Day 2025 marks the start of the New Paltz journey for the incoming class and their families
cards.access_notes: For incoming residential students and their families; follow current Housing move-in directions.

cards.title: Black History Convocation
cards.subtitle: Annual February community ceremony
cards.notes: Watch University and Black Studies announcements during Black History Month for performances, speakers and recognition at this annual campus gathering.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus ceremony honoring Black history and culture.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz described its 2025 Black History Convocation as the second annual ceremony and a celebration of Black history and culture.
cards.source_title: “Remember our legacy”: New Paltz’s second annual Black History Convocation uplifts and inspires
cards.access_notes: Programming is organized around Black History Month; check the University calendar for current details.

cards.title: Student Research Symposium
cards.subtitle: Annual student-faculty scholarship showcase
cards.notes: Plan around the spring symposium to view poster presentations and celebrate student-faculty scholarship; consult the current program for venue and schedule.
cards.short_summary: A yearly showcase of research and creative scholarship.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2025 program identifies the Student Research Symposium as SUNY New Paltz’s annual celebration of student-faculty scholarship and its 31st consecutive installment.
cards.access_notes: Event format and location vary by year; consult the current symposium program.

cards.title: 100 Days to Commencement
cards.subtitle: Senior countdown gathering
cards.notes: Graduating seniors can attend the annual countdown event to connect with campus resources and begin preparing for their final 100 days before graduation.
cards.short_summary: An annual senior milestone that starts the graduation countdown.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz reported that its annual 100 Days Kick-Off celebrated the Class of 2025’s 100 days remaining until graduation.
cards.source_title: President Wheeler’s Dec. 2024 Report to Faculty
cards.access_notes: Designed for graduating seniors; date and campus location are announced each academic year.

cards.title: Commencement
cards.subtitle: Old Main Quad graduation ceremonies
cards.notes: Graduates should follow the official Commencement page for ceremony assignment, ticket rules, lineup and weather-related updates before attending.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY New Paltz’s official 2026 Commencement page lists graduate and undergraduate ceremonies on Old Main Quad in May 2026.
cards.access_notes: Graduate open seating and undergraduate guest-ticket requirements are listed on the official current Commencement page.
